Elon Musk Regrets Republican Campaign Spending, Distances Himself from MAGA

Elon Musk stated he feels "pretty foolish" for spending over $400 million to back Republican candidates, admitting the political investment did not yield the expected results following the US midterm elections. He also distanced himself from the "MAGA" movement, asserting "I'm not Maga," despite past alignments with Donald Trump's movement.
